My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263),
I send you an [order](/topic/102) for the chapters of the Thorne that have appeared- also another to correct. I think people like it much - your neighbour [Miss Wilford](/person/1520) was talking about it yesterday she is staying with [her aunt](/person/384) at [St Cross](/organisation/130), and I am always much tempted to betray you

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
The Order is payable to Ann Smith - more names always cause blunders
